coordinate_contract.l1: Every L2 worker consumes an L1 crop and its screen xyxy bbox.
coordinate_contract.l2: Results use crop_xyxy and expose screen_* fields after bbox translation.
coordinate_contract.screen_coordinate_rule: screen_x = l1_bbox.x1 + crop_x; screen_y = l1_bbox.y1 + crop_y

click_safety_contract.fixed_controls: L1 identity plus an approved in-panel control template or OCR confirmation is required.
click_safety_contract.shop_sell: A sell button match never authorizes an item; external item_policy=allow_sell is mandatory.
click_safety_contract.unknown: Unknown identity, state, action, coordinate, or item policy exposes no click.

action_planner.rule: Only planner output action=click may be executed; minimap single-frame absent/unknown is noop.
action_planner.project_overrides: The packaged planner keeps the project player_health mode and <= threshold semantics while merging the upstream minimap policy.

pet.absence_policy: No L1 pet panel means resting_or_absent; unknown keeps previous state or noops.

pet_restore_skill.slot_policy: Scan pet active slot 1 and slot 2; click only when identity_state=matched and cd_state=ready.

minimap_tracking.state_policy: A marker in any frame is strong positive evidence. Single-frame absence is weak evidence. Stop polling only after at least 5 absent frames spanning 800ms and at least 3 failed target-acquisition attempts; target panel or world-monster evidence overrides absence.
minimap_tracking.resource_policy: Bright yellow diamond/quadrilateral resource markers are explicit non-monsters and never enable attack polling.

minimap_coordinate.engine_policy: 0-9 pixel templates are primary; Tesseract is fallback only.

shop_cleanup.item_policy: OCR item name plus external keep/sell allowlist; unknown item never sells.

known_data_gaps.core_l1_r6: train/artifacts/l1_layout_v2_20260710_r6_pet_lowhp is the promoted model; PT, ONNX, 95-image test, and 450-image regression all passed.
known_data_gaps.pet_label_review: 28 changed local pet labels and six target-reviewed overrides are pinned by train/reference/pet_label_manual_review_20260710.json.
known_data_gaps.l1_aux_native_variation: New panel captures are sequential; keep template fallback until independent sessions and native resolutions are collected.
known_data_gaps.shop_cleanup: The visual pipeline is complete, but the project owner must supply the item keep/sell policy.
known_data_gaps.town_return: Only two destination panels and one confirmation dialog are available; retain OCR gating.
known_data_gaps.world_monster_detector: No dedicated world-scene monster detector is promoted yet. Until one exists, repeated target-acquisition misses are required to confirm minimap absence.
